name: Linux Mint 22.3
blurb: The easiest landing off Windows — polished Cinnamon desktop.
usb: Flash the Cinnamon ISO with balenaEtcher or Ventoy (verify the checksum first).
install: Boot the live desktop → Install Linux Mint.
Language & keyboard → tick Install multimedia codecs.
Choose disk, create your user, reboot.
after:
sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y
sudo apt install -y build-essential git vim python3-pip

seed.c: Put this on my mom's laptop. Zero phone calls since. Says it all.
Great for beginners. Cinnamon is snappy even on old hardware.

update: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y

after:

name: Nobara

name: Arch Linux

seed.c: archinstall makes it 20 minutes now. Still learn more here than anywhere.
Perfect base for a Hyprland rice. Not for a first Linux though.

name: Kali Linux
blurb: The pentester's toolbox — hundreds of security tools, ready to go.

after:

sudo apt install -y kali-linux-large   # big toolset
note: Only test systems you own or are authorised to assess. Great in a VM.

name: Parrot OS
blurb: Lighter than Kali, with strong privacy tooling alongside the offensive kit.
usb: Flash the Security (or Home) ISO with Etcher.
after: sudo parrot-upgrade   # wraps apt full-upgrade
update: sudo parrot-upgrade       # Parrot's wrapper around apt full-upgrade

name: BlackArch
blurb: ~2,800 security tools as an overlay on Arch — for experienced users.
usb: Flash the full ISO, or add the repo to an existing Arch box.
install: Option A: curl the strap.sh and run it on Arch.
Option B: flash the ISO and install like Arch.
after:
curl -O https://blackarch.org/strap.sh
chmod +x strap.sh && sudo ./strap.sh
sudo pacman -S blackarch-webapp   # by category
note: Authorised targets only. The full group is enormous — install by category.
update: sudo pacman -Syu

name: Tails
blurb: Amnesic live OS routed through Tor — forgets everything on shutdown.
usb: Write Tails 7.0 with the Tails installer or Etcher (follow their steps for upgrades).
install: It runs from the USB — you don't install to disk.
Boot → Tails Greeter → optional Persistent Storage.
after:
# Amnesic by design — no package routine.
# Persistent Storage keeps the few things you choose.
note: Boot it on a machine that isn't your daily driver.

seed.c: For sensitive work there's nothing else. Leaves no trace, full stop.

update: # Amnesic OS — Tails checks for upgrades on boot and walks you through applying them.

after:
# Install apps inside a template, not dom0:

# Update via the Qubes Update tool.
update: # Use the Qubes Update tool in dom0. Each template updates inside itself.

name: NixOS 26.05
blurb: Your whole system as one reproducible config file. Roll back anytime.
usb: Flash the graphical ISO with Etcher or dd.
after:

sudo nixos-rebuild switch
# packages go in environment.systemPackages

seed.c: Once it clicks you can't go back. My whole setup is one file in git.

update: sudo nixos-rebuild switch --upgrade

name: Gentoo

sudo emerge -avuDN @world   # update (compiles from source)
note: Source-based. Budget real time — the Handbook is your friend.
